bio.text: Amy Grant is a Republican member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 47th District, serving since January 2019, according to the Illinois General Assembly.
Her legislature biography says she served on the DuPage County Board from 2012 to 2018 and has lived in Wheaton for more than 20 years.

It says her professional experience includes teaching in parochial and public schools and management and sales in the private sector, and that she earned a B.S. in education from the University of Pittsburgh.
